findings.issue: Task 1 Implementation hints say 'FunnelStepIdBackfill: inject MongoTemplate, use $set partial-update (e.g. Update().set("steps.$[].id", ...))'. The array positional-all operator ($[]) sets all array element ids to the SAME value — which is incorrect for assigning unique ids per step. The correct approach for this use-case is either an iterative per-document / per-step update loop or aggregation pipeline update. The hint mentions this as an example ('e.g.'), so it is not a strict prescription, but the cited example is technically wrong and could mislead the implementor.
findings.fix: Clarify the hint: $set with positional-all $[] assigns one value to all array positions — use an iterative approach (load document, generate ids per step, $set the updated array) rather than a single $[] update.

findings.issue: TDD Anchor says FunnelStepIdBackfillTest 'extends AbstractIntegrationTest' (iteration-1 critical finding resolved). However AbstractIntegrationTest starts Mailpit and Redis in addition to Mongo; the backfill test only needs Mongo.
